title: The plain bag, iv
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Thursday. Gully's. The letter, the figure, the whistle — 2007 again. Gully looks at the table-leg question with his eyes. Wood shakes his head: no room under the leg. It's level.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with the dog-food letter. WOOD on the stool. BARNABY II under it.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man in an apron reading a letter at his counter while a thin man sits on the end stool with a small three-legged dog beneath

panels.composition: Gully's whistle. The same small wavy line as 2007. Longer.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a stocky man giving a long low whistle drawn as a small wavy line

panels.composition: Gully looking at Wood. A question with no words: the table leg?

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man asking a thin man a one-word question across a counter

panels.composition: Wood folding the letter into his coat. The dog. The plain sack on the counter, refilled by Gully without being asked.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man folding a letter into his coat at a counter where a stocky man has set a refilled plain paper sack

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The 2007 whistle, longer. 'Level since March.' 'It's a good sack.'
